test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Jiten and Hiru __loves__ to __eat__ __French fries__ for __lunch__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

The error in this sentence is in the segment "loves to eat". Since there are two subjects ("Jiten and Hiru"), the verb must be in plural form to match.
